files.name: motion-prompt-068.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Step indicator" (ステップインジケーター), one of the names in "UI component names".
Motion Prompt #068

What it is: Shows which step of a process you are on
What the sample shows: Each click on "Next" turns the next of four step circles into a check and extends the blue line to the following step.
Spec:
- 4.5 s cycle on a 542×191 card. Four steps ("Details, Review, Payment, Done" in Japanese) at x 80, 207, 334, 461, y 35; circles of radius 17 joined by a 4 px grey line.
- The cursor clicks "Next" (110×38, bottom right) at 0.9, 1.7 and 2.5 s.
- On each click the current step becomes a blue circle with a white check and the next becomes the current one (blue circle, white number). Steps not reached are white with a grey rim.
- The blue line grows 127 px per click over 0.3 s with easeInOutCubic; after the third click all four are checked.
- Reset: the indicator fades out over 3.75–4.05 s and fades back in at step 1 over 4.05–4.3 s.
When to use it: Use it in multi-step flows such as sign-up or checkout to show progress and what is left.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/068.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/ui.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
